subject.title: improve: stream native sessions as hosts finish

question: Should the optional SessionCatalogListProviderParams.onHost callback and sessions.catalog.host event become the supported long-term progressive-delivery contract after the adoption-race regression is proven fixed?
rationale: This is a new plugin-facing and protocol-facing delivery surface; code review can assess mechanics, but maintainers must choose whether this is the intended stable extension boundary.

options.title: Approve the progressive contract after race proof
options.body: Retain the optional callback and event, provided the final head includes a regression test proving late host events preserve adopted session bindings.

options.title: Keep progressive behavior internal
options.body: Move the progressive coordination behind a core-owned interface and avoid exposing a new provider callback if maintainers do not want this SDK contract.

options.title: Pause for a narrower API proposal
options.body: Defer merging until the plugin SDK delivery semantics and upgrade expectations are documented and explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the progressive contract after race proof
recommendation.body: Retain the optional callback and event, provided the final head includes a regression test proving late host events preserve adopted session bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history ties this contributor directly to the new session-catalog delivery design, though current-main ownership evidence is limited.
